html:
SMTO-CMP-0019 — The AI's "not finished" report included success details

GUID: 7bd3ac46-5534-44ce-8f45-948de686d51a
Slug: completion-invalid-status-fields
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • The AI model reported that the task isn't fully done, but attached proof that only belongs with a finished task. SMTO asked it to correct the report. Work done so far is kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Read the task's latest reply to see what the AI says is still unfinished and why. The AI meant to report unfinished work, and its explanation tells you what's left.
  2. Check what already happened, in the task's steps or in the real system, before asking for more. Some changes may already be in place, and you don't want them repeated.
  3. Select Resume, or describe what's left in the "Continue this conversation" box under the task and select Continue. SMTO keeps finished work, so it can correct the report or finish only the remaining part.
  4. Don't select Restart task while you're unsure what already happened. Restart begins a fresh attempt and doesn't undo earlier actions, so changes could happen twice.

What success looks like

  • The task ends with a clear reply: Completed, or an explanation of what couldn't be done.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Check whether the earlier action already happened before anything is repeated. Don't restart the task while that is unclear.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • An incomplete terminal status (partial, blocked or failed) carried evidence, outcome_evidence or checks, which only answered or completed declarations accept (reason invalid_status_fields).

What this means

  • An incomplete terminal status carries success evidence or checks even though that declaration type does not accept them. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • An incomplete terminal status carries success evidence or checks even though that declaration type does not accept them.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the selected terminal status and its allowed fields before changing evidence.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the rejected finish_task status and its evidence, outcome_evidence and checks fields (_assess_incomplete in src/agent_runtime/native/completion.py). The model must omit those fields when reporting incomplete work, or declare answered or completed if the cited receipts actually establish success; no operation needs to run again.
  • Correct status fields using the advertised completion schema.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • The declaration accurately describes incomplete work using only its supported fields.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-EXE-0004 — Execution outcome is unknown
